text: It's time for the doctor to retire! He asked for 900 baht for his work, but I had doubts about his diagnosis, because the pimples did not cause me any discomfort.  Then the doctor charged 500 baht for a consultation.  And I went to another clinic where they told me that it was just a skin defect and there was no infection.  In 10 minutes, these formations were removed and I was sent home.  Therefore, read reviews about doctors and clinics, this can save your time, money and preserve your health.

restaurant_name: คลินิกตาหมอสุรศักดิ์
text: Let me share my experience to give others a chance. This morning I took my child to the doctor for redness in the whites of their eyes. I have to say, I wasn't impressed. I didn't expect to encounter a doctor with such a rude attitude at a clinic. Every word she said was incomprehensible. When I asked a question, she retorted, "Do you understand?" How could I understand when I haven't explained anything? She said my child has pterygium and that we should avoid sun, wind, and dust, and that my child needs to wear sunglasses (which cost 400 baht at the clinic). When I tried to avoid it because I was in a hurry to get my child to school and wanted to choose something that looked good, she snapped, "You keep procrastinating like this. Are you going to wait until the growth grows into your cornea and you go blind? Surgery is expensive. If you don't wear them, you'll have to close your eyes the whole way in the car, or just cover your head with a pipette!" I was confused why a doctor who runs a clinic would speak to a patient like that. So I quickly paid and received two bags of pills. There were no instructions or explanations about what the medication was for. I saw some eye drops and asked if they needed refrigeration. The doctor replied, "If you refrigerate them, you'll have to run back and forth between school and home!" I didn't want to argue because I was in a hurry and I saw the doctor was elderly. Thinking about it, the doctor might not realize the consequences of her actions. And I commend myself for remaining calm and not retaliating with insults. But I can tell you, customers who visit this doctor's clinic will probably only go once, and then spread the word, making everyone afraid to try again. There are many other good, skilled doctors to choose from.
author_name: วชิราภรณ์ บัวพันธ์

text:
Go somewhere else. Don't go here. Your eyes are delicate and dangerous if you make a mistake.
I had an eye infection and consulted here. The doctor, who was from a bank, didn't wash his hands and touched my eyes, which worsened the infection. When I was going to have the procedure, I said I wouldn't do it. If I had to have it done, I'd rather go to the hospital. The doctor was displeased and spoke rudely, saying, "It's just this. Why make it so difficult?" I noticed that his hands were shaking and the clinic was unclean, so I didn't do it and left. The next day, I went to the hospital. The doctor examined me and said I needed a high-powered microscope because the area was only 2 millimeters close to the tear duct. So, I had the surgery at a clean, safe, and standardized hospital. I'm glad I didn't have it done at the clinic because the area was so close to the tear duct. If I made a mistake and injured the tear duct, it would be dangerous.
In my personal opinion, it's better to go to a reputable hospital. I want everyone to be safe.
